description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaswaththa, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, identity card numbers, addresses, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes) and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
